# Commit Areas

## SAP Commerce Features
ACL · AI · Bean System · Business Process · CCv2 · Cockpit NG · DataHub · External Dependencies · FlexibleSearch · HAC · ImpEx · JS Storefront · OCC · Polyglot Query · Project Import · Project View · Solr · Type System

## IntelliJ Platform & Ecosystem
Angular · Ant · Copyright · Cron · Database · Diagram · Gradle · Groovy · Java · JPS Build · JRebel · JSP · JUnit · Kotlin · Maven · Plugin Development · Run Configuration · Scala · Search Everywhere · Spring · Terminal · WSL · xDebugger

# GitHub PR Labels

Source of truth: https://github.com/epam/sap-commerce-intellij-idea-plugin/labels
The PR feature label is the commit area (e.g. `Project View | …` → label `Project View`).

| Label                    | Description                                                                |
|--------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ACL                      | Access Control Lists language capabilities                                 |
| AI                       | AI related capabilities                                                    |
| Angular                  | Angular plugin integration & capabilities                                  |
| Ant                      | Ant plugin integration & capabilities                                      |
| Backport to 2026.0.16    | Indicates backported feature                                               |
| Bean System              | Bean System declared via `*-beans.xml`                                     |
| bug                      | Something isn't working                                                    |
| Business Process         | Business Process capabilities                                              |
| CCv2                     | SAP Cloud Portal & related features                                        |
| Cockpit NG               | SAP Cockpit NG, aka Backoffice                                             |
| Copyright                | Copyright plugin integration & capabilities                                |
| Cron                     | Cron Expression plugin integration & capabilities                          |
| Database                 | Database plugin integration & capabilities                                 |
| DataHub                  | Legacy DataHub                                                             |
| Diagram                  | Various Diagrams                                                           |
| External Dependencies    | External Dependencies capabilities defined via `external-dependencies.xml` |
| FlexibleSearch           | FlexibleSearch language capabilities                                       |
| Gradle                   | Gradle plugin integration & capabilities                                   |
| Groovy                   | Groovy plugin integration & capabilities                                   |
| HAC                      | Hybris Administration Console                                              |
| ImpEx                    | ImpEx language capabilities                                                |
| Inspection Rules         | Code insight inspection rules                                              |
| Java                     | Java plugin integration & capabilities                                     |
| JPS Build                | IntelliJ IDEA JPS based build process capabilities                         |
| JRebel                   | JRebel plugin integration & capabilities                                   |
| JS Storefront            | CCv2 Javascript Storefront based on SAP Composable Storefront              |
| JSP                      | Java Servlet Pages capabilities                                            |
| JUnit                    | JUnit capabilities                                                         |
| Kotlin                   | Kotlin integration & capabilities                                          |
| Maven                    | Maven plugin integration & capabilities                                    |
| Module Dependencies      | Module Dependencies capabilities                                           |
| OCC                      | SAP Omni Commerce Connect                                                  |
| Plugin Development       | Plugin itself development capabilities                                     |
| Polyglot Query           | Polyglot Query language capabilities                                       |
| Project Import           | Project Import & Refresh capabilities                                      |
| Project View             | Manage Project View capabilities for SAP Commerce Projects                 |
| Remote Logging           | Remote Logging capabilities. Manage loggers within the IDE                 |
| Remote Properties        | Remote properties capabilities, managed via HAC                            |
| Requires - Project Refresh   | Indicator that feature will require project refresh                    |
| Requires - Project Reimport  | Indicator that feature will require full project reimport              |
| Run Configuration        | Run Configurations, e.g. JUnit, Remote Debug, Server Start                 |
| Scala                    | Scala capabilities                                                         |
| Search Everywhere        | IntelliJ IDEA Search Everywhere capabilities                               |
| Solr                     | Solr capabilities                                                          |
| Spring                   | Spring plugin integration & capabilities, also simple community Spring version |
| Terminal                 | Terminal plugin integration & capabilities                                 |
| Type System              | Type System declared via `*-items.xml`                                     |
| Welcome Screen           | SAP Commerce Project Welcome Screen capabilities                           |
| WSL                      | Windows Linux Subsystem                                                    |
| xDebugger                | IntelliJ IDEA Debugger capabilities                                        |
